author: Vinheteiro
description:
Did you know that some of the most famous children's songs and nursery rhymes are hundreds of years old? In this video, I play 33 iconic children's melodies on the piano, organized by their year of origin and country—from the 16th century all the way to modern times.

You will be surprised to see how old songs like "Three Blind Mice", "Yankee Doodle", and even "Baby Shark" actually are.

Which of these melodies is your favorite? And did you know its true origin? Let me know in the comments!
